placement_criteria.d_f: whole recorded pick window (0 <= t < lift_t) of E0 and E3b: robot, target, other fruits >= 0.030 m
placement_criteria.c: recorded carry window (lift_t <= t < place_t): min(robot, target) <= 0 in every run with a carry window
